in_marathi.name: Kishore
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishore हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kishor', meaning the 'Lord of all senses'. In Hindu mythology, Kishore is a term used to describe Shiva as the Lord of all senses or the embodiment of sensual pleasure.
